entities.name: PMID:25451396
observations: Case-control study reported AIP and AC higher in bipolar/unipolar mood-disorder groups than controls; the mood-disorder-plus-tobacco-use-disorder group was higher than other comparison groups. Available summary provides no effect sizes or exact adjusted estimates.

source_tools.relevance: Primary evidence for AIP, AC, and tobacco comorbidity

entities.name: PMID:39793682
observations: Meta-analysis of 85 studies (14 bipolar, 71 MDD; 70,856 participants) reported increased pooled AIP across mood disorders (p<0.001); retrieved summary did not provide an AC pooled result or tobacco-comorbidity analysis.

source_tools.relevance: Pooled evidence for AIP in mood disorders

entities.name: Mood disorder AIP and AC
observations: A case-control study reported higher AIP and AC in mood-disorder participants, with the mood-disorder-plus-TUD group highest among comparison groups; subgroup effect sizes and adjusted estimates were unavailable in the retrieved summary.

entities.name: Pooled mood disorder AIP
observations: A meta-analysis of 85 studies reported significantly increased pooled AIP in mood disorders (p<0.001); it did not establish tobacco use as a modifier in the retrieved summary.
